newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Regional School Dist #15, Conn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Regional School Dist #15, Conn..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by Regional School District Number 15 of the State of Connecticut, at Day, Berry & Howard, CityPlace I, 25th Floor, Noah Webster Conference Room, Hartford, Connecticut 06103-3499, until 11:30 A.M. (Eastern Standard Time) on

for the purchase when issued, at not less than par and accrued interest from the date of the Bonds to the date of delivery, of the whole of $8,000,000 General Obligation Bonds, Issue of 1997, payable on March 1 in each year as follows: $350,000 in each of the years 2000 through 2002, $400,000 in each of the years 2003 through 2004, $450,000 in each of the years 2006 through 2009, $475,000 in each of the years 2010 through2011, and $500,000 in each of the years 2012 through 2017. Bonds maturing after March 1, 2006 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, at the option of the District, on or after March 1, 2006. The Bonds will be qualified tax-exempt obligations

State Street Bank and Trust Company of Connecticut, N.A., Hartford, Connecticut, and delivered against payment in Federal funds in New York, New York, on or about March 5, 1997, subject to the approving opinion of Day, Berry & Howard of Hartford, Connecticut. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, acting as securities

Notices of Sale, Bid Forms and the District's Official Statement may be obtained from Ms. Janette J. Marcoux, CIPFA, Senior Managing Consultant - Public Finance, at Independent Bond Investment Consultants, 273 Battle Street, Bristol, Connecticut 06010 (telephone: (860) 583-5133).
Chairman of the Board of Education
